title: Integrating Molecular Pathology, Radiology, and Genetics to Improve Breast Cancer Risk
official: Integrating Molecular Pathology, Radiology, and Genetics to Improve Breast Cancer Risk
summary: The purpose of this research is to better understand how benign breast diseases might lead to breast cancer, focusing on genetic factors and including a diverse range of participants to improve future diagnosis and treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female patients, ages 18 to 100 years
* Had a benign breast biopsy at Mayo Clinic between 2002-2022

Exclusion Criteria:

* All male patients
* Prior or concomitant diagnosis of BC
* Diagnosis of BC within six months of benign breast disease
* Denial of research authorization
* Concurrent or post-biopsy bilateral prophylactic mastectomy
